text:
incident-bot: Alert: Streaming proxy error rate elevated (5xx/timeouts) on region-us-west streaming-proxy-01. Threshold breached: 4.8% recent 5m. Symptoms: chunked-encoding disconnects, 502 gateway, client cancellations. Links: https://metrics.internal/streams/alerts/1790005678 :rotating_light:

Ethan (oncall): oncall here, acknowledging. Starting investigation. Adding SRE + eng-runtime.

Sophie: I see the spike in the streaming proxy logs — a lot of `upstream reset` and `client canceled` within the same window. Looks like chunked responses are failing to finish. Quick glance at LB shows increased 502s from the proxy to runtime.

Carlos: grabbing logs now. Running `kubectl logs -n prod streaming-proxy-01 -c proxy --since=15m | tail -n 200`

Carlos: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-14T20:27:32Z ERROR http: upstream reset by peer id=abc123 stream_id=482
2026-03-14T20:27:33Z WARN  http: client canceled, sent_bytes=0 path=/v1/stream
2026-03-14T20:27:34Z ERROR router: 502 from runtime-7 for request id=def456
```

Priya: Two hypotheses: 1) runtime instances are OOMing under a spike; 2) a recent proxy config change (keepalive/timeout) is too aggressive for certain client patterns. Any recent deploys?

Ethan (oncall): No prod deploys in past hour except a small proxy tweak by eng-runtime ~45m ago (increase keepalive to 30s). Rolling back might be an option.

Nina (SRE): CPU on runtime nodes looks okay, but there are signs of increased GC pauses on model-serving pods -> see p95 latency jump around the same time. Might be KV-cache thrashing with larger prefix requests.

Sophie: Reproducing locally w/ a long-lived stream client shows chunked frames being dropped when the backend pauses >200ms. We need a mitigation that prioritizes keeping streams alive.

Jordan (Support): We've got 3 customer reports (account: big-ux, analytics-co, videochat-inc) seeing failed streams and retries. They report timeouts and partial transcripts. Logged as INC-2319. Support flagged SLAs.

Priya: Immediate mitigations we can do (quick list):
- Increase proxy upstream timeout to 90s (from 30s)
- Enable fallback to non-streaming (polling) for known heavy clients via routing rule
- Reduce max_concurrent_streams per connection so one noisy client doesn't overwhelm
- Scale up warm pool of runtime instances by +30%

Ethan (oncall): I'll do the proxy timeout bump and scale the warm pool. Carlos/Nina can we coordinate? I'll push a small config change to the staging proxy, then to production via canary.

Carlos: Pushing config change now. Command: `kubectl apply -f prod/proxy/timeout-increase.yaml && kubectl rollout restart ds/streaming-proxy -n prod`

Carlos: Canary applied to 2 nodes. Monitoring metrics.

incident-bot: Metric update: 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% in canary group after 3m. Overall cluster still at 4.2%.

Sophie: Good sign. Concurrent stream limit change would help reduce head-of-line blocking. Can we set `max_concurrent_streams=50` on proxy for now?

Ethan (oncall): Doing it now. Applying patch.

Carlos: Patch applied across fleet. Rolling restart in progress.

incident-bot: After fleet restart: global 5xx down to 1.6%, streaming disconnects down ~70% from peak. Still seeing intermittent client cancellations for long-lived >2m streams.

Jordan (Support): Customers updated: big-ux acknowledges improvement, analytics-co still seeing occasional partial transcripts but degraded frequency. We've asked customers to retry and provided status link.

Priya: Longer term we should add graceful draining support to runtime KV-cache and increase keepalive on runtime side, or add explicit backpressure signals for streaming. Also create a routing rule to fallback to batch endpoint for clients that retry >3 times.

Nina (SRE): I also want to capture specific traces for impacted requests. Starting distributed tracing capture on streaming-proxy -> runtime path for requests flagged with 502 in last 10m.

Sophie: Found a correlated change: a change in model quantization rollout earlier today increased memory pressure for one runtime variant; that variant is heavily used for streaming low-latency workloads. Will coordinate rollback if needed.

Ethan (oncall): For now we're leaving timeouts and concurrent stream limits. Observability shows error rate below threshold for 10m. Can we mark this as mitigated and monitor for 30m? If the GC/quantization variant is implicated we should open a rollback and postmortem.

Carlos: Opening rollback PR for the quantization config to be ready if errors reappear: PR#4567.

incident-bot: Current status: mitigated (reduced impact). 5xx at 0.9% cluster-wide; streaming disconnects significantly lower. Alert suppressed for 30m.

Jordan (Support): Notifying account reps for the three impacted customers; offering extra support and credits if they request.

Priya: Action items:
- (Priya) Follow up on routing fallback rule (TICKET-3421)
- (Carlos) Post-deploy verification for proxy change + canary notes (TICKET-3422)
- (Sophie) Root-cause analysis on quantization rollout and GC traces (TICKET-3423)
- (Nina) Collect and attach relevant traces & logs to the postmortem (TICKET-3424)

Ethan (oncall): I'll stay on for the monitoring window and then hand back to daily oncall in 30m. If error rate climbs above 2% re-escalate.

Sophie: One more note — for immediate customer-side mitigation we provided a snippet to disable streaming and fall back to polling:
```
POST /v1/stream -> 503 -> client: switch to POST /v1/generate with `stream=false`
```

Jordan (Support): Sending follow-up messages to customers with that snippet.

Ethan (oncall): Thanks all. Marking thread resolved->mitigated. Will create postmortem draft after full trace collection.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Duration: ~34 minutes. Postmortem owner: Sophie. Link: https://incidents.internal/postmortems/INC-2319

Sophie: I'll draft the postmortem and include timeline + mitigation notes. Will ping for reviews. :memo:

Carlos: uploading logs and the canary results to the ticket.

Nina (SRE): Leaving a note to add synthetic streaming checks to our SLO suite to catch chunked-encoding regressions earlier (TICKET-3425).

Ethan (oncall): handing off to daily oncall @here — please monitor the dashboards for next 2h.

Jordan (Support): Closing INC-2319 once postmortem links and customer comms are finalized.

Sophie: Thanks team. Good cross-team work. :clap:
